scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('styles.min.css', fs.readFileSync('styles.css','utf8').replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').replace(/\s*([{}:;,])\s*/g,'$1').trim()); fs.writeFileSync('script.min.js', fs.readFileSync('script.js','utf8')); console.log('Assets built successfully.');"
